title: Gumdrop Summer
blurb: Milky ribbon, summer triangle, candy-colored wonder.
whisper_start: Summer glass is sticky-sweet. Wide triangle: Porch star (Altair) → Lantern (Vega) → Dragon tail (Deneb). Candy glows are scattered across the whole sky — take the long way.

pins.label: Porch star
pins.note: Altair — the bright porch light of summer. Wave at the dogs. Sit a breath; W to leave when ready. The rest of the candy is far — look for the radar, not a pile at your feet.

pins.label: Lantern
pins.note: Vega again, but warmer — a lantern high on the sticky night. Long climb northwest from the porch. Name one summer sound if you want.

pins.label: Dragon tail
pins.note: Deneb — far and soft. The dragon’s tail of the summer ribbon, opposite the long candy trail. Looking is playing.

drift_mysteries.label: gumdrop spark
drift_mysteries.story_hook: A gumdrop spark far west of the porch — sticky light on a long detour, not stacked on Altair.

drift_mysteries.label: candy dust
drift_mysteries.story_hook: Candy-colored dust on the far side of the sky — past the dragon, not under its chin.

mystery.label: the gumdrop
mystery.story_hook: The gumdrop itself — unlabeled sweet in the open south-central sky. Press P and claim it for the house.

house_pins.label: summer porch rail
house_pins.note: House light down the yard from Porch star — walk the rail, don’t sit on Altair’s lap.
house_pins.whisper_notice: 📌 summer porch rail — warm wood a walk from the porch light.
house_pins.whisper_center: 📌 “summer porch rail” — the dogs know this stretch of sky.
